name: LP-MSPM0C1104 LaunchPad
description: Tiny, very cheap USB-C LaunchPad for the MSPM0C1104 (24 MHz Cortex-M0+, 16 KB flash) with an on-board XDS110-class debug probe, LED, button and 20-pin BoosterPack headers.
notes: The MSPM0C1104 comes in tiny packages (the 8-pin variants have 6 GPIO, the larger VSSOP-20 up to 18); gpio = 6 is a conservative estimate for the board even though it has 20-pin BoosterPack headers.
TI list price at launch was $5.99; DigiKey and Mouser listed $7.19 (tariff note). Board size and GPIO count are estimates.
